The player and chapter identify recording 259821 as the corresponding 2024 Capital Bond Streets and Transportation Meeting (provider-player; native-source-chapters). Assign both the dedicated subcommittee feed and the broader Bond Program Meetings subscription grouping under the configured bond-family publication rule. The family feed is not a separate convening body.
